title: Lightning starterpacks: Web + API + CLI examples with streaming & retry ergonomics
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a set of small, opinionated starterpacks and cookbook snippets across Next.js (TypeScript), FastAPI (Python), and a Go HTTP server + CLI that demonstrate production-ready streaming ergonomics, retry strategies, and telemetry best practices for Redwood SDKs. Goal: reduce time-to-first-success for engineers integrating Redwood by providing reusable patterns (serverless-friendly streaming, backpressure-aware generators, idempotent retry helpers, prefix caching examples) and CI-tested templates that can be copied into customer projects.
acceptance_criteria: Three runnable templates: Next.js TypeScript app demonstrating streaming to client + server-side caching; FastAPI async endpoint with generator-based streaming and retry middleware; Go HTTP server sample with middleware for batching and a small CLI that can replay requests.

Each template includes a short README with integration steps, environment variable examples, and recommended SDK configuration for production (retries, backoff, idempotency keys, batching thresholds).
Automated tests in CI that run a lightweight integration test for streaming and retry behavior (mocked Redwood runtime).
Telemetry hooks included (SDK metrics + example dashboard) and a short doc describing how to surface KV-cache hit rate and streaming latency in Redwood Console.
steps: Finalize API surface notes for examples: Python context manager pattern, TS async iterator, Go channel-based stream wrapper.
Implement Next.js example: serverless edge streaming using event-stream with small client hook and retry wrapper for transient failures.
Implement FastAPI example: async generator endpoint, client snippet with exponential jitter backoff and idempotency-key helper.
Implement Go HTTP + CLI: middleware that accumulates small requests into a batch, CLI that can offline-replay requests for local dev and debugging.
Add telemetry: emit count of prefix cache hits, per-request latency histogram, and retry counts; include Grafana/Console dashboard sample.
Write CI integration tests: simulate transient failures to validate retry logic and validate that streaming responses are delivered end-to-end.
Docs and README polish: copyable snippets, security notes (avoid logging PII), and recommended production config.
